humanAcceptance.evidence: Dave explicitly instructed Codex to push this Pass 70 live additionally so he can test it in a browser, while retaining Pass 69 and Pass 63. This authorizes publication for testing; it does not claim Dave has completed remote browser testing of Pass 70.

requirements.summary: Publish Pass 70 as an additional browser-testable release
requirements.expected: The public chooser routes Pass 70 to channels/the-big-one and legacy latest, normal and room links continue to select Pass 70.
requirements.falsifier: Pass 70 is absent, routes to another pass, or a legacy latest, normal or room link selects an older channel.

evidence.note: Dave explicitly authorized publication of Pass 70 so he can test it remotely in a browser.

requirements.summary: Retain exact Pass 69 and stable Pass 63 alongside Pass 70
requirements.expected: The chooser exposes exactly Pass 70, byte-exact retained Pass 69, and stable Pass 63 WebGL; the internal Pass 67.1 subtree remains staged but is not selectable.

evidence.note: The served three-card chooser routed Pass 70, exact Pass 69 and Pass 63 to their distinct runtime trees with zero failures.

requirements.falsifier: Any correction is absent from the exact candidate, its focused adversarial test fails, or authority differs between offline, host, guest, self, friendly, enemy or bot topologies where the requirement applies.

requirements.summary: Complete owner testing on the public Pass 70 URL
requirements.expected: Dave can test the exact public Pass 70 build remotely and report any remaining visual, audio, collision or frame-pacing defect without losing Pass 69 or Pass 63 access.
